Titus Sardine Carton Prices in Nigeria (August 2026)

Titus Sardine Carton Prices in Nigeria (August 2026)

Foodstuffs No Comments

For many Nigerians, their trip to the market or shopping mall is not complete without picking a tin of Titus Sardine. This product has been on the market for several decades and keeps growing stronger. While some folks aren’t so disposed to the idea because of the so-called “smell,” others cannot do without Titus Sardine.

What is the current price of the Titus Sardine carton in Nigeria? Where can one buy this product in this part of the world? What are the health benefits of eating Titus Sardine?” Continue reading this post to find out the answers to these questions.

Titus Sardine Carton Prices in Nigeria

Sardines are popular in Nigeria, even though we refer to them more as Titus fish. This fish is what is put into cans and sold as Titus Sardine. The product is manufactured by a Moroccan company known as Unimer Group SA. This brand has been in partnership with a Nigerian company called Ekulo International Limited to distribute its product in Nigeria.

How much does Titus Sardine cost in Nigeria today? Over the years, the price of this product has increased steadily in the Nigerian market due to several factors. Because of this, it is important to first find out the cost of a carton of Titus Sardine before going to the market. You should consider buying a carton if you have a large family, are planning an event where you will need Titus Sardine, or are a retailer.

We have surveyed the market on your behalf to make your job easier. The list below shows the different Titus Sardine carton sizes and their current prices in Nigeria.

  • Titus Sardine Fish 50 Pieces (1 Carton): From N35,000
  • Titus Sardine Fish 25 Pieces (Half Carton): From N18,000
  • Titus Sardine Fish 12 Pieces (Quarter Carton): From N9,000

PRICES LAST UPDATED: MARCH 4, 2024.

As mentioned earlier, the cost of this product fluctuates frequently because of factors like government policies, import duties, haulage, and so on. Keep checking our page as we will constantly update this post with the latest prices for these products. You will also notice slight price variations depending on your location and who you patronize.

Where to Buy Titus Sardine Carton in Nigeria

Now, that you know the cost of Titus Sardine cartons in Nigeria, another important question comes to mind. Where can you buy Titus Sardine by the carton in Nigeria? The two options are buying in person and buying online.

If you choose to buy in person, you can choose any of these locations:

  • Local market
  • Distributors (for wholesalers)
  • Wholesalers (for retailers)
  • Supermarkets

To place your order online, you should consider any of these websites:

  • Jumia
  • Konga
  • Jiji
  • Yaoota

Kindly note that delivery costs apply and they are calculated by the distance of your location from the vendor. As such, you should only consider this option if you are buying large quantities.

Health Benefits of Titus Sardine

Have you been wondering why you should consider eating Titus Sardines? Well, this section will show you a few health benefits that accrue to consuming this product. Before then, the list below shows the nutritional information of Titus Sardine per 90 grams:

Amount Per Serving

  • Calories from Fat 132
  • Calories 224
  • 23% Total Fat 15 g
  • 22% Saturated Fat 4.4 g
  • Trans Fat 0 g
  • 27% Cholesterol 80 mg
  • 11% Sodium 270 mg
  • Sugars 0 g
  • Protein 23 g
  • 0% Vitamin A
  • 0% Vitamin C
  • 57% Calcium
  • 13% Iron

With this out of the way, here are some health benefits of consuming Titus Sardine:

Strengthens the bones

From the list above, you will agree that Titus Sardine contains a healthy amount of calcium. This means that it will help to make your bones and teeth stronger. It is perfect for people that are lactose intolerant since they can’t consume milk, another rich source of calcium. This product also contains phosphorus and vitamin D, both known for strengthening the bones.

Great source of protein

A tin of Titus Sardines contains 23 grams of protein. This shows that this product is one of the best sources of animal protein you will find on the market. Proteins are very important to give us a balanced diet, especially for kids.

Reduces inflammation

Titus Sardines also help to reduce inflammation that can result in several diseases. The reason for this is that this product contains DHA and EPA. Both are types of fatty acids that help your body to combat inflammation by dealing with infections.
